messages.content:
{{USER_INSTRUCTION}}ROUND 1 [provide: image_1, image_2]
Query: Check my 'Shopping List' project on Todoist. If the items in these two pictures are on that list, find them on Amazon, add them to my cart, and then cross them off Todoist.
Instructions: Ask the assistant to check your Todoist 'Shopping List' project and cross-reference it with the items shown in the two images. Instruct the assistant that if the items match, it should search for them on Amazon, add them to your cart, and then delete the corresponding tasks from Todoist. Wait for the assistant to confirm that these actions are complete before moving to the next round. If the assistant asks for clarification on what the items are, direct it to analyze the images provided.

ROUND 2 [provide: image_3, image_4]
Query: Here are two more things. Actually, wait, I changed my mind about buying stuff today. Let's just save them for later. For these new pictures, if they're on the Todoist list, look them up on Amazon but put them in my wish list instead of the cart. Also, take those first two things out of my cart and move them to the wish list too. Don't forget to delete the Todoist tasks for these new ones.
Instructions: Present the two new images and inform the assistant that you have changed your mind about purchasing the items today. Instruct the assistant to search for the new items on Amazon and add them to your wish list instead of your cart, provided they are on the Todoist list. Remind the assistant to delete the Todoist tasks for these new items. Crucially, ask the assistant to move the two items from the previous round out of your Amazon cart and into the wish list. Proceed once the assistant confirms the new items are processed and the old items are moved.

ROUND 3 [provide: image_5, image_6]
Query: Last two pictures. Do the exact same thing: check the list, find them on Amazon, add them to the wish list, and delete the tasks. Once you're done with all that, send an email to my wife letting her know all the items we managed to match and put on the wish list today.
Instructions: Ask the assistant to process the final two images using the updated wish list workflow: cross-reference with Todoist, add to the Amazon wish list, and delete the Todoist tasks. Then, instruct the assistant to draft and send an email to your wife summarizing all the items that were successfully matched and added to the wish list across all three rounds today. If the assistant asks for your wife's contact details, tell it to use the profile information. End the conversation once the assistant confirms the email has been sent.

You have 6 images available to share with the agent using the send_message_with_image tool.
IMPORTANT: Image IDs are ZERO-INDEXED integers (0, 1, 2, ...). Do NOT add 1 to the IDs.
Available image IDs: [0, 1, 2, 3, 4, 5]
Image mapping:
  image_1.jpg -> image ID 0
  image_2.jpg -> image ID 1
  image_3.jpg -> image ID 2
  image_4.jpg -> image ID 3
  image_5.jpg -> image ID 4
  image_6.jpg -> image ID 5

## IMAGE DELIVERY

⚠️ IMPORTANT: You MUST use the `send_message_with_image` tool to share images with User B. Do NOT just describe images in text — you MUST call the tool.

Image delivery schedule:

  Round 2: YOU MUST call the send_message_with_image tool with image_ids='2,3' — do NOT write the tool name as text; use the actual function call. Include a natural, conversational message to the assistant.
  Round 3: YOU MUST call the send_message_with_image tool with image_ids='4,5' — do NOT write the tool name as text; use the actual function call. Include a natural, conversational message to the assistant.

entity_data.subject: Items added to our Amazon wish list today
entity_data.body:
Hi Angelica,

I successfully matched the following 6 items from my Todoist shopping list and added them to our Amazon wish list today:
- Nerf water gun
- Car radiator
- Geological hammer
- Sony WF-1000XM5 earbuds
- Assembled Maze Puzzle Block Secret Box
- ION Drum Rocker Rockband 2 Premium Drum Set

Best,
Dillon
